common_prefix: Response contract v1: Output exactly one line, then end the response. No reasoning, explanation, Markdown, quotes, or prefix. Do not invent missing values.
answer_template: If all required items are observed, output {answer_format}
missing_template: If a required item is unavailable, follow the task: output exactly UNKNOWN, or Please provide <fields>. Replace <fields> with missing names only, ordered {field_order}, separated by comma-space.

finite_state.answer_format: only S0, S1, S2, or S3.

tool_recovery.answer_format: exactly RETRY lookup, VERIFY receipt, or STOP.

scoring.single_line_compliance: Strip surrounding whitespace, require nonempty and no internal CR or LF; report separately from unchanged parser/task score.
scoring.success_gate: 16/16 valid grammar and single-line compliance, all EOS/no caps; task correctness and per-family/action errors reported independently, with no model promotion from this dev probe.

stopping_rule: One fresh frozen-original run of all sixteen preselected cases, cap32 each; no checkpoint save, no optimizer update, no after-result prompt/parser/cap tuning. Preserve failures and predeclare a separate future diagnosis if needed.
interpretation: Paired exposed-development instruction intervention; cannot establish broad generalization, architecture gain or isolate which sentence helps. Old capped prose includes an unsupported START=S0 assumption; not all failures can be attributed to formatting alone.
